title: Springfield, Missouri regional-discovery/local-tracking demo
intent: A reproducible case definition and readiness contract; it is not evidence that data or model outputs have already been downloaded.

location.relationship_to_event: inside the SEVIR catalog bounding box and approximately 4.9 km from its geographic center
location.disambiguation: Always include Missouri or the coordinates; Springfield alone is ambiguous.

cascast_window.rationale: Segment 1 maps the previous hour through the event reference time to the following hour used for verification.

sevir_catalog_records.role: CasCast-native VIL history and later VIL verification

sevir_catalog_records.catalog_note: The source row ends with a duplicated +115 minute offset instead of +120; preserve the catalog row and do not silently repair it.

regional_discovery.initialization_policy: Choose an ERA5-hour-aligned initialization time during preparation and record the exact valid-time mapping in the generated manifest.
